imported report contents are not independently verified
session-assisted fixture ledger is not actual chat/API billing and integration wall time is not inference latency
all API export destinations were an owned loopback Collector
initial mobile table over-wrapped; final bounded scroll table rechecked
browser tab and owned application server closed after acceptance

limitations: complete unified-trace gate open: inspecting a child alone currently produces a standalone root trace; durable host trace binding across entry points remains to be implemented
this is an explicit saved-journal projection, not a live process-global subscriber or W3C external-service header propagator
separate records are read atomically but do not form one transactional parent/child snapshot
generation metrics are saved checkpoints; active reservation journals can be newer; committed includes uncertain-attempt ceilings
embedding uses an independent host ledger and has no per-run allocation here; generic tool-service billing is unknown, not zero
old missing clocks remain missing; session roots remain open because the runtime has no session-close operation
explicit repeated snapshot exports can resend completed span IDs; no exactly-once telemetry guarantee or automatic retry
OTLP per-trace gauges are not process-wide cumulative counters, invoice totals or native latency rankings

native execution binary and final projection binaries have different hashes; immutable native journals were reprojected after adding control spans and local UI metadata, without any new generation calls
browser comparison is descriptive only; report files are not attested and the standalone LangGraph schema needs an adapter
network edge cases use separately labelled mock receivers; official Collector validates the actual successful wire path
